messages.content: Build a quick auth check script.
I'll write a script that checks JWT tokens. Let me create auth-check.py...
No, don't put it in the root. Use scripts/ — that's where utility scripts go in this project.
Also you forgot the shebang. Always include #!/usr/bin/env python3 in scripts.
Right — adding the shebang and making it executable.
And the verification step — when you say done, run the actual command and show me the output. Don't just claim it works.
Understood. Running the script now to verify...
